name: openpaperdesign
description: Edit a design project in your workspace with an agent and in an editable canvas in the in-app browser (paper-rs, local only).

interface.longDescription: Binds one paper-rs design project in the workspace, lets the agent edit it over MCP, and opens the editable canvas in the in-app browser on a loopback URL. Local only: no cloud, no telemetry. Not affiliated with Paper (paper.design).
